name: Git Commit
description: Stage approved paths only, fail closed on unrelated staged changes, and commit a no-op if no approved-path changes are staged.

guardrail_repo.description: Path to the Guardrail checkout that contains the git commit wrapper helper

repo_path.description: Relative path to the target git repository

paths.description: One or more relative repo paths to stage. Repeat --input paths=... to pass multiple paths.

message_file.description: Relative path to a commit message file. File contents are content-hash bound at approval time.

steps.description: Stage approved paths, fail closed if unrelated files are already staged, commit only approved paths, and return success when there is no-op staged content.

constraints: Only the explicitly approved repo_path, staged paths, and commit message file may influence the commit
Commit message file is content-hash bound at approval time and rechecked before execution
No shell mode, no push, and no additional git flags are allowed through this recipe
The wrapper fails if already-staged changes exist outside approved paths
The wrapper commits only the approved path list
invariants: At least one staged path must be present
Commit message comes from the approved message_file path
No-op success is returned when approved paths produce no staged changes
This recipe never performs git push
